Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-prompt-medium-0200", "row_sha256": "c3a6818d038342c292ace0f64507246e14e073171c71749d4d1abfd2ba325279", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you turn these notes into an internal update for payroll and finance about the may 2025 payroll export? it was run on 29 may at 3:40 pm from the payroll system and has 84 active employee records. the csv is in the shared Finance/Payroll/May folder. it has employee id, department, gross pay, deductions, the last four digits of bank accounts, and cost center. finance confirmed the file opens and its totals match the payroll register. three employees have no cost center in the export. hr says the updates were submitted, but they aren't showing in this file yet, and we don't know whether a refresh is scheduled. access to the shared folder is limited to payroll and finance. please don't include any individual pay or bank details in the update. make it a straightforward status update with a clear final section called current assessment. the assessment should say that right now the file is usable for gross-pay review but not ready for cost-center reconciliation until the three missing values are checked, and that this applies only to the may export. if hr's updates show up before a refresh, say they need to be verified against the source record before the assessment is revised. don't claim that anyone's pay was delayed or that a refresh has been arranged.", "output": "Draft a straightforward internal status update for payroll and finance about the May 2025 payroll export. Use the facts below and do not include individual pay or bank details.

- The export was run from the payroll system on 29 May at 3:40 pm and contains 84 active employee records.
- The CSV is in the shared Finance/Payroll/May folder, which is accessible only to payroll and finance.
- The file contains employee ID, department, gross pay, deductions, the last four digits of bank accounts, and cost center.
- Finance confirmed that the file opens and its totals match the payroll register.
- Three employees have no cost center in the export. HR says the updates were submitted, but they are not yet reflected in the file. It is not known whether a refresh is scheduled.

End with a clearly labeled section, “Current assessment.” State that the file is currently usable for gross-pay review but is not ready for cost-center reconciliation until the three missing values are checked. Make clear that this assessment applies only to the May export. If HR’s updates appear before a refresh, say they must be verified against the source record before the assessment is revised. Do not claim that anyone’s pay was delayed or that a refresh has been arranged."}]
